standards.name: VM0051: Improved Management in Rice Production Systems
standards.scope: Methane and nitrous oxide emission reductions in flooded rice cultivation via water regime improvements and organic management.

standards.name: Bureau of Energy Efficiency - Carbon Credit Trading Scheme (CCTS)
standards.body: Bureau of Energy Efficiency / Ministry of Power, India
standards.scope: Indian compliance mechanism covering 7 obligated industrial sectors with voluntary agricultural offsets framework in phased development.

practices.name: Safe Alternate Wetting and Drying (AWD)
practices.description: Field water depth allowed to drop to 15 cm below soil surface before re-flooding, measured via perforated field water tube. Continuous flooding resumed 1 week before flowering to 1 week after flowering.
practices.source: IPCC 2019 Refinement, Vol. 4, Ch. 5, Table 5.12; IRRI Rice Knowledge Bank

practices.name: Direct Seeded Rice (DSR) with Mechanised Drill
practices.description: Direct drilling of pre-treated seeds into unpuddled soil, avoiding nursery preparation and prolonged puddling anaerobic conditions.
practices.source: ICAR-NRRI Cuttack Agronomy Guidelines; IPCC 2019 Refinement
